q: Do you play seated, standing, or both?
why: Sets body height, reach, and whether turning your body can steer.

q: Which machine runs the game when you play: a PC streaming to the headset, or the headset itself?
why: That's where Steam Input, the mod and the logs live.

q: May the agent launch and stop the game itself on the rig machine (never on your saves)?
why: Without it every test waits for you.

q: Must your own saves never be loaded or touched? (Tests use a separate test save.)
why: Saves are backed up either way; this decides whether tests may ever read them.

q: How sensitive are you to motion sickness?
why: Sets turning, vignette and how cuts are hidden.

q: Immersive like Half-Life: Alyx (info on the gear, quick physical actions) or like a sim (every step by hand)?
why: Most people find full sims tiring after an hour.
Smooth turning makes some people sick.

q: How much flat UI will you accept where no physical home fits (subtitles, system messages)?
why: Everything else goes on the body, gear or world.

q: Which mechanics do you care about most? (They get built and tuned first.)
why: Order of work after the vertical slice.
recommend: the ones used most per minute

q: Ship new physical features on by default (you turn off what you don't like), or off?
why: Off by default made most of the Subnautica mod invisible.
